For a time, Sudanese expected a peaceful return to civilian rule. Then came April 2023 and two years of civil war. Tens of thousands of people have been killed and more than 13 million uprooted, with reports of rape being used as a weapon of war across the country. The UN also says it's the world's biggest crisis of hunger and displacement. And the effects of the war are spreading beyond Sudan's borders.
